conversations.empty.search_body: Search matches titles only. Try another word, or look in another tab.

platform.scope.rest: what you do here takes effect across tenants, and every action is written to the operation log.
platform.forbidden.title: You don't have permission to open the platform admin
platform.forbidden.body: Only platform administrators can use these pages. The menu doesn't show them to anyone else.
platform.impact.title: What will happen
platform.error.outcome_unknown: It is not known whether this went through. Check the operation log before you try again.
platform.dialog.default_description: Check what will happen, then confirm.
platform.stale.title: The state changed after you opened this
platform.stale.body: Someone else changed this tenant. Nothing was written. Look at its current state, then decide.
platform.stale.refreshed: The state changed meanwhile, and the page shows it now.
platform.tenants.title: Tenants
platform.tenants.description: Every tenant, suspended and deleted ones included. Open a tenant for its state, quota, members and operation log.
platform.tenants.load_failed: The tenant list can't be loaded right now
platform.tenants.empty_body: Self-service sign-up opens in MS6. Until then new tenants are created here: choose a plan and invite the first admin.
platform.tenants.no_match_body: No tenant has this name or ID with this status and plan.
platform.tenants.caption: Tenants, {count} rows
platform.tenants.current_suspended_body: Tenants, the operation log and AI settings keep working. Gateways, the device pool and provisioning events need another, working current tenant: choose one in the organization menu, or resume this one.
platform.create.title: Create tenant
platform.create.description: Choose a plan and invite the first admin. That admin then manages the tenant; the platform administrator does not become a member.
platform.create.name: Tenant name
platform.create.name_hint: Shown in the tenant switcher; not written to logs or events.
platform.create.overrides_hint: Enter a whole number, or “unlimited” where a limit is allowed to be unlimited.
platform.create.email_hint: They get an invitation email; an address without an account gets one through the invitation.
platform.create.submit: Create tenant and send the invitation
platform.create.review.name: Name
platform.create.audit: Logged: the tenant's creation and the invitation of the first admin, two entries, with you as the actor.
platform.create.open_list: Open the tenant list in a new tab
platform.create.reconciled: I looked at the tenant list and “{name}” is not there
platform.create.unknown: It is not known whether the tenant was created. Look at the tenant list before you create it again.
platform.create.partial_invite: Tenant “{name}” was created, but the invitation was not sent
platform.create.partial_plan: Tenant “{name}” was created, but its plan was not set
platform.create.open_log: Open the tenant's operation log in a new tab
platform.create.partial_checked: I looked at the operation log and the {step} did not go through
platform.create.partial_body: The tenant exists: don't create it again, that would make a second tenant with the same name. Try the steps that did not go through again, or open the tenant.
platform.tenant.load_failed: The tenant can't be loaded right now
platform.tenant.not_found_body: The link may be wrong, or the tenant was removed.
platform.tenant.copy_failed: The tenant ID could not be copied.
platform.tenant.state.title: State
platform.tenant.state.description: Suspending blocks the API and AI, revokes all gateway certificates and disconnects them.
platform.tenant.final_note: A tenant whose contract was terminated can't be resumed or given another reason; it will only be deleted afterwards. The suspend and quota buttons are not offered.
platform.tenant.processing.lead: The suspension is recorded and waits for certs to confirm.
platform.tenant.step.blocked_detail: From the next request; a token already issued works for up to 60 more seconds.
platform.tenant.step.waiting_detail: Certificates revoked, CRL in effect, gateways disconnected. “Suspended” shows only after the confirmation; there is no timeout.
platform.tenant.stuck_title: certs has not confirmed for over 10 minutes
platform.tenant.stuck_body: The gateways may still be connected. This usually means certs' subscription is behind or stuck; “Suspended” is shown only after the confirmation and is never assumed.
platform.tenant.quota.title: Quota
platform.tenant.quota.description: Plan {plan}. Going over a limit only blocks adding more; what exists keeps working.
platform.tenant.quota.extra_note: A temporary raise of {extra} until {until}; after that the plan's {plan} applies again.
platform.tenant.recent_description: This tenant's operation log, newest first.
platform.members.load_failed: The members can't be loaded right now
platform.members.empty: This tenant has no members yet.
platform.members.caption: Members, {count} rows
platform.members.rescue_description: For when the tenant's admins are locked out. Only users who already have an account; no account is created.
platform.members.rescue_note: This is written to the tenant's operation log; the tenant's admins can see it was set by a platform administrator.
platform.member.title: Make {email} {role}?
platform.member.description: You are changing the members of “{tenant}” as a platform administrator.
platform.member.token_note: Takes effect from the next request; a token already issued carries the old role for up to 60 seconds.
platform.member.audit: Logged in the tenant's operation log: the actor (a platform administrator), the member, the previous role and the new role. The tenant's admins can see it.
platform.suspend.title: Suspend “{name}”
platform.suspend.description: Suspending blocks all the tenant's users and AI at once and disconnects its gateways.
platform.suspend.description_reason: The tenant stays suspended; only the recorded reason changes.
platform.suspend.hint.security_or_abuse: Can be resumed after the investigation.
platform.suspend.hint.contract_terminate: Final: it can't be resumed or given another reason; the tenant will only be deleted.
platform.suspend.final_body: It can't be resumed or given another reason, and the tenant will only be deleted. If you only want to pause the service, choose non-payment or security or abuse.
platform.suspend.impact.members: {count} members are blocked from their next request and see only the suspension page.
platform.suspend.impact.gateways: {count} gateways have their certificates revoked and are disconnected once the CRL is updated; their data is buffered on the gateway.
platform.suspend.impact.processing: The status shows “Processing” first, and “Suspended” only after certs confirms.
platform.suspend.type: Type the tenant name “{name}” to confirm
platform.suspend.understood: I understand that ending the contract can't be undone
platform.suspend.same_reason: This is already the reason; choose another one.
platform.suspend.audit: Logged: you as the actor, the reason “{reason}”, the state version {from} → {to} and the time (the server's clock).
platform.suspend.done: The suspension of {name} was sent and is processing. It shows “Suspended” after certs confirms.
platform.suspend.done_reason: The reason for suspending {name} was changed.
platform.resume.title: Resume “{name}”
platform.resume.description: After this the tenant is active at once, without waiting for the services downstream.
platform.resume.impact.members: {count} members can use it from their next request.
platform.resume.impact.gateways: Gateways get new certificates at their next renewal and reconnect; buffered data is sent afterwards.
platform.resume.audit: Logged: you as the actor, the state “suspended ({reason})” → active, the version {from} → {to}.
platform.quota.title: Adjust the quota of “{name}”
platform.quota.description: The plan {plan}'s default is in each hint. Going over a limit only blocks adding more; what exists keeps working.
platform.quota.use_default: Use the plan default for the gateway limit ({default})
platform.quota.gateways_invalid: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
platform.quota.extra_hint: Only until the end of this month, then the plan's {plan} applies again.
platform.quota.extra_invalid: Enter an amount of 0 or more.
platform.quota.reason_hint: Written to the operation log; the tenant's admins can't see it.
platform.quota.below_title: The new limit {limit} is below the {used} in use
platform.quota.below_body: The {used} existing gateways keep working, but this tenant can't bind a new one until it has fewer than {limit}.
platform.quota.audit: Logged: the actor, the values before and after, the reason and the period they apply.
platform.gateways.title: Health and device pool
platform.gateways.description: Every gateway registered at the factory: those waiting are in the device pool, bound ones show their tenant and health.
platform.gateways.load_failed: The gateways can't be loaded right now
platform.gateways.suspended_body: The gateway pages need a working current tenant: the services answer 403 for a suspended one. Choose another tenant in the organization menu, or resume this one in the tenants.
platform.gateways.health_unavailable_tit: Health data can't be read right now
platform.gateways.health_unavailable_bod: The list still shows where each gateway is; the health reads “Unknown”, not “Offline”.
platform.gateways.caption: Gateways, {count} rows
platform.gateways.empty_title: The device pool has no gateways waiting
platform.gateways.empty_body: Gateways appear here after a production workstation registers them at the factory.
platform.gateways.empty_tenant_body: Bind one from the device pool.
platform.gateways.partial_scope: Search and filters look only at the {count} gateways loaded so far. Load more to include the rest.
platform.gateways.type_last4: Type the last 4 characters of the hardware ID, “{value}”, to confirm
platform.gateways.type_full: Type the whole hardware ID “{value}” to confirm
platform.gateways.bind.title: Bind {id}
platform.gateways.bind.description: Only after binding does the gateway have a role on the broker and receive certificates of this tenant.
platform.gateways.bind.tenants_failed: The tenants can't be loaded right now.
platform.gateways.bind.full_title: The gateway quota of “{name}” is full ({used} / {limit})
platform.gateways.bind.full_body: Raise the quota before you bind.
platform.gateways.bind.full_link: Open the tenant to adjust the quota
platform.gateways.bind.audit: Logged in the tenant's operation log: the actor, the hardware ID and the binding ID.
platform.gateways.unbind.title: Unbind {id} from “{tenant}”
platform.gateways.unbind.impact.revoke: Revokes the gateway's current certificate, updates the CRL and disconnects it from the broker.
platform.gateways.unbind.impact.pool: Clears the old configuration; the gateway returns to the device pool and can be bound to the next tenant.
platform.gateways.unbind.impact.card: Always fit a new SD card before handing it to the next tenant.
platform.gateways.unbind.impact.backlog: After unbinding it can't reach the broker: the {count} buffered rows that were not uploaded yet may never reach the old tenant.
platform.gateways.unbind.impact.backlog_: After unbinding it can't reach the broker: data still buffered on the gateway may never reach the old tenant.
platform.gateways.unbind.audit: Logged: the actor, the hardware ID, the previous tenant and the serial numbers of the revoked certificates.
platform.gateways.unbind.done: {id} was unbound and is back in the device pool.
platform.gateways.repair.title: Send {id} for repair
platform.gateways.repair.description: Revokes the certificates and unbinds it from the tenant, and marks it as in repair; after the repair it returns to the device pool.
platform.gateways.repair.note_hint: What is wrong and the ticket number, for example “power module fault, RMA-2026-118”.
platform.gateways.repair.audit: Logged: the actor, the hardware ID, the previous tenant, the note and the revoked certificates.
platform.gateways.repair.done: {id} was unbound and marked as in repair.
platform.gateways.revoke.title: Revoke the certificates of {id}
platform.gateways.revoke.key_compromise: With “key compromise” this gateway can never get a certificate again, which is the same as decommissioning it.
platform.gateways.revoke.audit: Logged: the actor, the hardware ID, the reason and the serial number of every revoked certificate.
platform.gateways.decommission.title: Decommission {id}
platform.gateways.decommission.descripti: A decommissioned gateway leaves the device pool for good: its certificates go on the revocation list and it can't be bound or renewed again.
platform.gateways.decommission.bound: It is bound to “{tenant}” now and will be unbound, and its configuration cleared.
platform.gateways.decommission.unbound: It is not bound to a tenant.
platform.gateways.decommission.understoo: I understand that decommissioning can't be undone
platform.gateways.decommission.audit: Logged: the actor, the hardware ID, the previous tenant and the revoked certificates.
platform.provisioning.title: Provisioning events
platform.provisioning.description: The factory registrations of the production workstations. The registration itself is done on the workstation; this only shows the record.
platform.provisioning.load_failed: The provisioning events can't be loaded right now
platform.provisioning.load_failed_note: The events are kept by the services and catch up when it works again.
platform.provisioning.empty_title: No factory registration in this period
platform.provisioning.empty_body: They appear here after a workstation registers a gateway.
platform.provisioning.caption: Provisioning events, newest first, {count} rows
platform.audit.title: Operation log
platform.audit.description: The append-only event log, newest first. Platform-wide events (model roles, factory registrations) and each tenant's events are queried separately.
platform.audit.platform_note_title: Model role changes are ordered by version
platform.audit.platform_note_body: When two administrators change a role almost at once, the log's order is not necessarily the order of the changes; the version in the summary is. The AI gateway's change record is the final authority, and a change whose outcome was unknown may have no entry here.
